plan.source: 60 existing development queries with actual global retrieval; no positive injection
plan.scope: Only baseline near ties may change order, with top-3 and top-6 evidence membership protected.
plan.selection: Require positive development MRR gain and no individual labelled-rank regression, then prefer minimum near-tie span, alpha, changed query count. Otherwise use the explicit alpha-zero fallback. Also retain the unconstrained maximum-MRR choice.
